decisions.rationale: The 2025 NOA shows $98,000 and the bi-weekly pay stub annualizes to about $99,000, supporting the stated $99,000.
Chequing balance of $101,509 with about 4 months of steady history and only payroll deposits covers the $65,000 down payment and closing costs.
The appraisal was prepared by Evalu-Rapide Plus, which is not on the approved panel.
The 2026-08-02 letter on letterhead, signed by HR, confirms permanent full-time employment since 2019 with salary consistent with the application.
